description: This file is a test suite for the WebSocket mock bus, testing subscription and publishing behavior in a mock WebSocket environment within the project.

methods.name: subscribe and publish delivers messages
methods.description: Tests that subscribing to a topic and publishing messages to it results in the payloads being received as expected.

methods.name: publishing to topic with no subscribers is safe
methods.description: Verifies that publishing to an unhandled topic does not cause errors.
